Meeting Date;                 3/15/2023
Sponsor(s):                   Scott (24)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 2-J at 3411 W Flourrnoy St
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                         ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is

hereby amended by changing all of the RT4 Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District

symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 2J in the area bounded by:

       West Floumoy Street; a line 98.31 feet west of the west line of South Homan
       Avenue; the public alley next south of and parallel to West Floumoy Street; a line
       123.31 feet west of the west line of South Homan Avenue,

to those of an RS3 Single-Unit Detached House District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and due pi|blication.



                                            Monique L. Scott
                                            Alderman, 24"^ Ward




Common Address:              3411 W. Floumoy Street (16-14-405-017)
